summary.text: Kolasinski is the Democratic nominee and a business owner with an associate degree from Owens Community College and a bachelor's degree from Siena Heights University. His campaign website lists government accountability, economic opportunity for workers, and healthcare cost reform among its main policy objectives.

paragraphs.text: Earned an associate degree from Owens Community College and a bachelor's degree from Siena Heights University.
His career experience includes working as a business owner.
Won the May 5, 2026 Democratic primary for Ohio's 4th District; this is his first race listed on Ballotpedia.
